description.zh:
日志订阅类型。取值：

- **risk**：表示风险信息。
- **event**：表示攻击事件信息。
- **asset**：表示资产信息。
description.en:
The type of the log subscription. Valid values:

- **risk**: risk information.

- **event**: attack event information.

- **asset**: asset information.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
日志存储地域ID。


> 您可以通过调用[DescribeUserSlsLogRegions](~~2712598~~)接口查询用户可用的日志存储地域。
description.en:
The ID of the region where logs are stored.

> You can call the [DescribeUserSlsLogRegions](~~2712598~~) operation to query available log storage regions.

description.zh:
日志服务SLS日志库LogStore的名称。

> API安全日志仅支持投递到以apisec-开头的LogStore中。
description.en:
The name of the Logstore in Simple Log Service.

> API security logs can only be delivered to Logstores whose name starts with apisec-.

description.zh:
日志服务SLS的Project的名称。

> API安全日志仅支持投递到以apisec-开头的Project中。
description.en:
The name of the project in Simple Log Service.

> API security logs can only be delivered to projects whose name starts with apisec-.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-log-delivery --instance-id waf_v3_public_cn-uqm2z00000a --assert-key risk --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-name apisec-project-1431657200000000 --log-store-name apisec-logstore000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
